name: successor-installed
purpose: Verify the current v2 Linux wheel in an isolated target on D: with actual WSL software Vulkan upload/shutdown checks
additional_observations: A separately registered run under the same owner/budget may use the unchanged state-query/capture and real eight-branch Tk workflow protocol against the same exact wheel. Record actual toolkit/device/exit identities. These observations prepare candidate records; they do not grant observer, absence, profile or release admission.
reuse: Existing CPython3.12.13, read-only dependency site-packages and the pinned external Mesa driver. Offline no-deps copy-mode target install; no environment creation, native build, driver rebuild or dependency download.
registry: Guest view inherits all Windows D: registry protection/block entries plus the original guest registry entries, with exact origin paths/hashes retained. Native drive paths are translated to their existing /mnt/<drive> names, never to aliases or relocated inputs.
filesystem_checks: Check guest and writable D: filesystems for read-only status and enforce the 10 GiB reserve. Installed files, temporary extraction, caches and logs use D:, whose Windows backing volume is /mnt/d. C: source and existing guest dependencies remain read-only inputs.
terminal_cleanup: Await every child, preserve actual exits/waits and failures, retain exact sources/licenses/evidence outside scratch, then inspect/apply the unchanged strict cleanup plan through the guest registry view and rehash retained files.
scope: Local installed WSL software Vulkan verification only; no physical GPU, mandatory profile, source/scope review, release admission or publication transfer.
